instruction: Use ANSYS through the interactive graphical interface to reduce the mass of a load-bearing structural part. Read C:\Users\user\Desktop\problem_spec.json and start from C:\Users\user\Desktop\baseline_apdl_hole_plate.db with its baseline result file C:\Users\user\Desktop\baseline_apdl_hole_plate.rst. Keep the fixed support region, loaded region, material elastic properties, analysis type, mounting and loading interfaces, and outer envelope unchanged. The model uses a consistent N-mm unit system, Young's modulus 210000 MPa, Poisson's ratio 0.3, an allowable equivalent stress of 160 MPa, and a maximum allowed displacement of 0.8 mm. You may remove or redistribute material inside the allowed envelope. Save the final native database as C:\Users\user\Desktop\submission.db and the final structural result as C:\Users\user\Desktop\submission.rst.
